name: Pathmaster
source:
Magics and Wonders, Royals and Nobles that have powers, Man like species such as Anthros and Elves. 『Pathmaster』 presents you a world which is full of familiar, but unrealistic features.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017580/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
魔法与奇迹、拥有力量的王族与贵族，以及兽人、精灵等类人种族。《Pathmaster》呈现了一个充满熟悉却又不切实际事物的世界。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017580/]Steam[/url]]
